name: Javier Mendoza
bio:
Javier's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by his family's involvement in local rally events. While studying engineering, he volunteered as a track marshal, developing a keen eye for safety protocols and risk assessment. This experience led him to pursue a career in motorsport security. He believes a proactive approach, thorough planning, and meticulous execution are paramount to ensuring the safety of the team and assets.

Javier joined ROWE Racing after impressing senior management with his detailed security proposals. His youth belies a maturity and dedication to his role that is highly valued. He is known for his unwavering commitment to maintaining a secure environment and his ability to anticipate and mitigate potential threats. 

Despite his serious demeanor, Javier has a strong sense of camaraderie and is always willing to lend a hand, whether it's assisting with vehicle checks or providing guidance to junior team members. His dedication to his role has quickly made him a valuable member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Javier is of average height with a muscular build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Insists on using military time exclusively.
Always carries a small notebook and pen to document potential security risks.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, even after others have verified them.
